text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $77k despite modest losses, while Ethereum has weakened more noticeably at -1.2%, signaling slightly softer conviction in risk assets. The Fear & Greed index remains in greed territory at 61 but has retreated 12 points over a week, suggesting sentiment is cooling from earlier enthusiasm. Bitcoin dominance at 58.9% and volume at $54B indicate a market that's present but cautious, with no clear directional conviction.
